title: Jesus... Every Aunty At Diwali Asked What I Earn
topic: relatives asking salary questions at the Diwali table while her job hunt is still going nowhere

bible.text: But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added unto you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... every aunty at Diwali asked what I earn. What do I even say? 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Forty applications this month. Nothing came back. My cousin cleared his interview in one try.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: They counted your salary twice. Nobody asked what you survived this year.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But You say You’ll provide. It’s November and nothing came.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Provision isn’t late because the table is loud. Your worth wasn’t on that menu.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Seek Him first. The rest follows, even when it walks slower than your cousin.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Which family question do you dread most? 👇
